title: Vertical Superset
description: Vertical push-pull supersets: decline push-ups, chair dips and Hindu push-ups for a dense upper body

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs, return feet together

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate rounding and arching the back, breathe

exercises.name: Inchworms
exercises.instructions: Standing, walk hands forward into a plank, then walk back

exercises.name: Decline push-ups
exercises.instructions: Feet elevated on a chair, body braced

exercises.name: Scapular push-ups
exercises.instructions: In a plank, squeeze and spread the shoulder blades without bending the elbows

exercises.name: Chair dips
exercises.instructions: Hands on the edge, elbows back, lower to 90 degrees

exercises.name: Inverted row (table)
exercises.instructions: Under a table, pull your chest toward the edge

exercises.name: Hindu push-ups
exercises.instructions: Diving motion: swoop down then rise up in an arc

exercises.name: Prone T raises
exercises.instructions: Lying face down, arms in a T shape, squeeze the shoulder blades

exercises.name: Chest stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm against a wall at 90 degrees, rotate your body

exercises.name: Triceps stretch
exercises.instructions: Arm behind the head, pull the elbow with the other hand

exercises.name: Scorpion stretch
exercises.instructions: Lying face down, bring the foot toward the opposite hand while rotating

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
